$comment: Single source of truth for managed coding-agent plugins. Top-level marketplaces/plugins/mcpServers are Claude Code declarations; codex.marketplaces/plugins are Codex CLI declarations (Codex MCP servers are tracked directly in target/home/.codex/config.toml as [mcp_servers.*]). install/common/agents.sh registers marketplaces, installs plugins, and adds each Claude mcpServers entry idempotently via `claude mcp add --scope user`; scripts/dotfiles/update.sh 'plugins' updates them. Claude marketplace names must match the source repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json because settings.json enabledPlugins keys on <plugin>@<name>.
